analysis_steps.goal: Measure multi-band photometry at ALMA positions

method.value: Align images to ALMA astrometry, PSF-match, 3'' aperture photometry (3.8'' for IRAC) with aperture corrections

evidence.quote: We then measure photometry in a $3''$ diameter aperture using the iraf package apphot.

key_parameters.value: 3 sigma detection threshold; errors from random blank-sky apertures

evidence.quote: In all of the following analysis, we define detections if the flux is 3 $\sigma$ above the background noise.

analysis_steps.goal: Derive photometric redshifts by SED fitting

method.value: hyperz chi2 fitting of Bruzual & Charlot templates with four SFHs, z=0-7, A_V 0-5, Calzetti law

evidence.quote: We use the spectral templates of (cite: Bruzual03), with solar metalicities, and consider four SFHs; a single burst (B), constant star formation (C) and two exponentially decaying SFHs
We therefore can be confident in the reliability of photometric redshifts derived from detections in four photometric bands, and adopt this limit throughout our analysis.

assumptions.value: Calzetti dust law; galaxy age less than age of Universe

evidence.quote: We also include the constraint that the age of the galaxy must be less than the age of Universe.

fitting.value: minimum chi2; 99% hyperz intervals adopted as 1 sigma errors

evidence.quote: we determine that the Hyperz “99 per cent” confidence intervals provide the best estimate of the redshift error

validation.value: Photometric offsets calibrated on 5942 spectroscopic galaxies; compared to 22 ALESS spectroscopic redshifts

evidence.quote: measuring a median $\Delta \,z\,$ / $( 1+z_{\rm spec} ) = 0.011\,\pm \,0.002$

analysis_steps.goal: Estimate redshifts of the 19 poorly detected SMGs

method.value: Stack in IRAC and SPIRE; assume M_H distribution complete at z<2.5 and assign M_H to place them via selection limits

evidence.quote: we construct $\sim$ $1000$ realizations of the ALESS SMG $H$-band absolute magnitude distribution over the range $z=0$–2.5 and compare this to the $H$-band absolute magnitude at $z>2.5$.

assumptions.value: M_H distribution not bimodal; undetected sources lie at z>2.5

evidence.quote: that the 19 SMGs detected in $<4$ wave-bands lie at $z>2.5$ and that the absolute $H$-band magnitude distribution is not bimodal

validation.value: Herschel stacks show the sources are real

evidence.quote: The SMGs are clearly detected at $> 4\sigma$ in all SPIRE bands in both the 0-or-1- and 2-or-3 subsets

method.value: M_H from best-fit SED times M/L_H from burst and constant SFH Bruzual & Charlot models, averaged; Salpeter IMF

evidence.quote: We note that all the stellar masses quoted here are for a Salpeter Initial Mass Function (IMF)

assumptions.value: SFH age restricted to 20 Myr–1 Gyr

evidence.quote: We enforce the condition that the age of the star-formation event is $20$ Myr $\le$ $t_{\rm age}$ $\le$ $1$ Gyr.

validation.value: Compared to dynamical and gas masses of similar SMGs

evidence.quote: we can crudely test their accuracy by comparing them to the dynamical masses, and CO–derived gas masses, of similar SMGs.

findings_qualitative.value: The ALESS redshift distribution declines steadily above z~2.5 rather than plateauing at high z

evidence.quote: the redshift distribution of the ALESS SMGs declines steadily from $z$ $\sim$ $2.5$ and does not plateau at high redshift ($z>3$)

claims.hypothesis: The SMG redshift distribution has a large high-z tail
claims.experiment: Photometric redshifts for ALMA-identified SMGs plus estimates for faint sources
claims.finding: Proportion of SMG-phase galaxies at z>=3 is at most ~35%, declining at high z

evidence.quote: the proportion of galaxies undergoing an SMG-like phase at $z\,\ge\,3$ is at most $35\,\pm\,5$ per cent of the total population

claims.hypothesis: SMGs are progenitors of local ellipticals
claims.experiment: Fade H-band luminosity assuming 100 Myr burst and compare with PM2GC
claims.finding: Consistent with a simple model in which SMGs form most stars in luminous ellipticals

evidence.quote: their descendants at $z$ $\sim$ $0$ would have a space density and $M_{H}$ distribution which are in good agreement with those of local ellipticals.

claims.hypothesis: ALMA blank maps contain multiple faint SMGs
claims.experiment: Stack Herschel and ALMA 870 um at 3.6 um sources
claims.finding: Faint SMGs exist but do not explain all missing flux

evidence.quote: Although we cannot explain all of the missing flux, these results do indicate that the ALMA blank maps contain multiple faint SMGs
